description: Fork of exp157. STE-blend annealing that cannot be compensated by attn_scale: forward A = A_soft + α * (A_hard - A_soft).detach(), with α = step/n_steps linear from 0 (pure soft, == exp154) to 1 (pure hard argmax, == exp157 STE). Backward gradient flows ONLY through A_soft (the α*(A_hard-A_soft) term is detached), so attn_scale stays usable to set surrogate sharpness, but at α=1 the forward is independent of attn_scale (pure argmax). This preserves exp154's training signal early, gradually shifts forward to hard, ends at hard attention by design. Hypothesis: starting soft and slowly moving to hard avoids exp157's slow-learning trap; final val_bpb should land near exp154/156 (1.71) while operating in pure hard attention.
